title: OceanBench insights manifest
description: insights/manifest.json for one (challenger, year, region) (contracts.md §4). Maps a semantic insight key to the descriptor of a content-hash-named, immutable, CDN-cacheable blob.

propertyNames.description: Semantic insight key (e.g. "aggregate-map", "spectra", "eddies", "trajectories", "class4-matchups"). Keys may be suffixed when several artifacts of a kind exist.

schema_version.description: Version of the payload schema for this kind (version string). Lets a viewer refuse or adapt to an unknown payload shape.

bytes.description: Size of the blob in bytes (aids client fetch budgeting).
